reason: After a successful enable, EnableTwoFactorModal.tsx:135 only sets the DisplayBackupCodes step. resetState() and onEnable() run only from the backup-codes-close button (lines 266-269), while Esc or an overlay click goes through onOpenChange, which at two-factor-auth.tsx:64 just toggles enableModalOpen. So viewer.me is never invalidated, the switch and badge stay stale, and because the modal stays mounted, reopening shows the old backup-codes step.
